newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Travel expects stable results.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Travel expects stable results.

text.p: The Shanghai China International Travel Service Co Ltd said on Tuesday it expected to report results for 1996 roughly similar to 1995, with earnings per share expected at 0.35 yuan against 0.34 yuan in 1995.
A company statement said turnover in 1996 was expected to reach 505 million yuan against 479 million yuan in 1995, based on domestic accounting standards.
Post-tax profits were forecast at 42 million yuan against 41 million yuan with a net asset per share unchanged at 2.67 yuan, the statement said.
The company has 60 million B shares listed on the Shanghai stock exchange with a current price/earnings ratio of 10.5 compared with 10.2 last year.

The statement said the company was considering new investment projects including the renovation of major hotels and setting up new tourist sites, and that it expected an increase of eight percent in turnover per year over the next five years.
